name: show_products
description: Show the good-better-best option cards on the buyer's screen. Call right after get_offers. Pass ids only. When the options are for a line already in the basket, also pass its line_id: the cards then offer 'Replace line N'.

offer_set_id.description: offer_set_id exactly as returned by get_offers.

line_id.description: Optional: the basket line these options are for, line_id exactly as a basket tool returned it. Leave it out for a new need.
